title: Prove the chart-510 price and the exact domain of a cheaper rewrite
body:
## Result

Five rank-one MOVEs are necessary and sufficient at chart 510 on arbitrary inputs when the exterior paid packets keep their native normalized values. The destinations may wait for their first actual readers, local history and recoding are free, and new nested projectors are allowed. The two dimension cuts and the early parity reader force the original hub. A separate direct-sum argument gives the exact price 5m for m independent clean instances with a common legal hub, for 0.9 ≤ t ≤ 1.

A literal rewrite removes two rank-one MOVEs and retains all 3,433 private clears. It preserves all outputs exactly when two independent helper XORs vanish. The unrestricted local map has rank 628 of 630. Rewriting any m of the actual 36 calls gives rank 18,906 − 2m on independent constant fields. This rules out recovery solely from the changed final outputs. The package supplies both kernel vectors and the exact forward and reverse readouts.

At κ = 0.00389046 the priced 268-factor example needs at least 25 genuine two-rank-one to one-rank-two substitutions. Twenty-four fail even the raw comparison. With 25, the candidate histogram passes the numerical checks for both suppliers and all 54 strict and four functional signed gates. Realizing that histogram, preserving the owners and pricing an entire changed application remain open. A transport certificate excludes positive raw margin above the existing ceiling for the two documented full-rank Boolean support rules. The complete conditional comparator remains #8035.

## Scope and reproduction

This follows [ToikY’s clock 8105 handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/7111#discussioncomment-19799234). #7833 concerns an earlier word.

Ran on CPython 3.12 from the pinned base with the proposed package installed:

```sh
python3.12 -IB scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-chart510-transfer-bound
```

The registered replay passed. Controls include the helper-266 and helper-254 output errors, exact collisions, signed boundary rejection and a corrupted one-tick transport. The clean direct-sum statement and the all-subsets caller statement have explicit proofs in PROOF.md. The smallest follow-up is to bind an existing exterior packet to a missing helper parity and verify its displaced reader at the real clock, or exhibit and price a powered schedule with both residuals vanishing.
